Effective 4 November 2026

This policy describes the cookies and similar technologies that this website actually uses. We have kept the website deliberately simple: it does not use analytics, advertising or social-media tracking, and it sets no cookies of its own.

01What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device so that it can remember something about you or your visit. Similar technologies, such as browser local storage, do the same job in a different way. Cookies set by the website you are visiting are called first-party cookies; cookies set by another service embedded in the page are called third-party cookies.

02Cookies this website uses

First-party cookies: none. The website does not set cookies or use browser storage. Fonts, scripts and stylesheets are served from our own domain, so viewing the pages sends no request to a third party.

Third-party cookies: Google Maps on the Contact page. The Contact page embeds an interactive map of our office from Google Maps. When that page loads, your browser requests the map from Google, and Google may set its own cookies and collect information such as your IP address and how you interact with the map. We do not control these cookies. Google describes them in its cookie policy and privacy policy.

03How to manage cookies

Because the website sets no cookies of its own, there is nothing to switch off here. To control the Google cookies from the map you can:

  • block third-party cookies in your browser settings, which still lets the map display in most browsers;
  • clear cookies after your visit; or
  • avoid loading the Contact page and use the address, telephone number and email address shown in the footer instead.

Instructions for managing cookies in common browsers are available from the browser makers: Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge.

04Changes to this policy

If we add a service that uses cookies, we will update this page and, where the law requires it, ask for your consent before those cookies are set. This version is effective from 4 November 2026.
